newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber flat in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber flat in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in slow late trading on Monday, with few fresh enquiries heard, dealers said.
Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices were at 54.75-55.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.50-54.75 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 54.00-54.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"We are negotiating to sell SIR20 at 54.50 fob Palembang to some European firms. We expect to secure deals later today," one Jakarta dealer said.
